I don't see how with all this ai technology, they can't just compare your photos and info to help you regain access. I make a new account with every new phone...

The update is horrible. I can't refresh it, and half of my photos are there. sometimes it switches back to the old way, and I can do everything and have all of my picture, and other times it's the new one. I keep getting so frustrated with how it is working now. I need some of these photos and can't see half then and there is nowhere or no way to find or get to them. The phone I have doesn't have its own photo app, so I can't even switch back to anything. I would give 5 stars to the old updates.

I hate this app. I can never find a photo Im' looking for unless I scroll through multiple categories. Why can't everything be in one place so you don't have to search through the "library" of categories. It automatically places them in a certain spot without giving you a choice. AWFUL. I get so frustrated when I want to pull up a photo on my phone to show someone and them it takes me 5 minutes to find it.

I like it a lot, and spend time on it everyday, organizing albums. When I am with friends or relatives, showing the forgotten photos is a high moment. I just don't understand why some photos don't allow people identification. I would also like to have access to a file browser do that I could spot An and delete the hundreds of photo duplicates I have (same picture, filename and date).

I love this app! Very easy to use, love the added suggestions it has for albums, panos, movies, animations, and more! I don't know how long it's been around but I can't believe I just got it a last year. It makes life so much easier when you want to save photos and videos but you don't want to burn up space on your phone! In the past I had to manually back them up, this does it for me automatically! Some people worry about photos in the cloud. I'm very cautious, but not tin-foil hat paranoid!

Face tagging is absolute garbage. Manual tagging is a must and Google does not provide this. It did recognize me, but only a few photos were added. I could not tell it that other photos were of me too. Same story with friends, pets, you name it. Albums aren't in alphabetical order either (which may not bother some people but there should at least be an option to put them in alphabetical order). I do not recommend this app to anyone.

does "photos" take photos or store/edit them? the camera takes good photos. The photos app stores them well (but it can be a little counterintuitive finding photos). what more can i say? whichever one it is, the editing tools are standard and a bit limited. i have no idea if i can buy more tools, but I have no intention of spending money on something that should be included.

Great right up until Google Software Engineering removed the Library option from the bottom of the app and left us with "collections" Now instead of instantly being able to access your folders, you have to navigate through "Collections" then "on this device" Only then do you have access to your folders, putting unnecessary layers of file structure ahead of the original file structure. Collections, albums, and folders should all be one in the same, with one name. Frustrating to say the least.

Would love it more if it allowed me to just copy/paste from the inventory stash when on my desktop. I don't want to have to download all the time. But to me its the best all around. I love the things the app puts together for me and the memories it brings up has me crying sometimes. I love the "now and then's" and the albums, books it builds for me. I also really extreamly love the fact that I can make movies. I can also merge other videos together to make an awesome funny time changing movie.

This is the only photo program available on the Google phone. It can be difficult to find photos. Sometimes they end up in the cloud and not available on the device. Sometimes they are on the device. There seems to be no rhyme or reason to which location takes priority and features to move/download photos are not always present. Google falls short with this. I miss the ease of use of iPhone's photo app.

How much would we like YouTube if it wasn't free to upload? Such a huge bummer that they took that away with Photos. I have free photo backup with Amazon prime, so there's not a good reason to stay here and start paying double. I'm seriously super bummed though. I was this app's biggest advocate. /// ... Also wish you could edit a photo from the album view... Also wish they had a blemish tool.

Google photos is by far the most difficult to use app for organizing photos I've had on my phones over the years. I tried using a different app, but then Google prevents me from attaching photos to texts. I use my camera for work and to keep records of my equipment model numbers etc. Every time I try to move a photo to an "album" or "folder", it's a major undertaking. The app keeps moving things around. It's like they're hiring teenagers to write these apps.

Annoying, inconvenient, time consuming problem when I save some photos from the Web, Facebook or Pinterest to the Google Photos gallery. They don't always show up at the top of the gallery like you'd expect. I find them(if I'm lucky) buried hundreds of photos deep in the gallery instead of at the top! Why do they do that? Does it have to do with the source for the photo, the date of the original photo?

Fun, easy way to organize, share, and play with photos. I've backed up tens of thousands of images and videos with the desktop app and could literally play with them all day every day on my phone for years if I had the time. It also makes great movies and photo books all by itself or you can do them on your own. Try searching beach, chair, dog, it's AMAZING!!! Also frees up storage on your phone. It's humanity's greatest accomplishment.

NO! As soon as my photos were backed up, they disappeared off my phone and were not placed in the folders I had created. And I can no longer find thousands of them. This is going to be a big time wasting mess! Don't do it! One other problem... now that the photos have disappeared from my device I cannot even retrieve them when I'm trying to attach them to messages or any other app. This is extremely frustrating and I wish they would just allow me to undo those changes.

Feels like focus on the Photos app has cooled off. Recently ran into a random limitation of photos in a live album with no way to create a new non-duplicative album and the responses to the community on the forums are "that's enough photos, you should delete some".... It's a product I pay monthly to use with my storage subscriptions, don't tell me how to use it random non-Google employee. It would be nice to see this resolved by setting a start date on an album.

Junk. Absolute junk. I had put information on photos that I had created through a jigsaw puzzle game, backed them up, and uploaded a good chunk of them to my preferred cloud drive. But when I returned to the photos that I had left on this gallery app. POOF. That information and alterations erased. Sad excuse of a gallery app. Remove it. It's a waste of space and my time. 🤬🤬

Maybe the best for photo backup. The search is also really useful! It would be even better if you could find an album alphabetically when you add photos. It would save time when you have many albums..! I sometimes have problems with shared albums. So I use Airdrop with my family and Airbum with my friends and colleagues. But for storage, Google is still the best!

Not sure why so many people say the app makes you pay you to print your own photos... You don't get charged If you use your own printer and ink... Duh. The app works fine for what you need it for. It Stores and organizes media, you can search for photos with keywords, you can make minor tweaks and edits, but don't expect to be able to get Photoshop features out of it.

I have used this over (edit 5) years now and it's great. It has lots of features and so many options. I have kids so I will take many photos in rapid succession and then go back to find the good ones, but photos will take all of those and put them together for a short animation sequence that is really neat. Still think this is fantastic. The reminders that bring up pictures taken 1, 2, 4, or more years back is always fun to see.

Scrapbooking and photo album on the go. I have gone on many trips and when you get on the plane, the things you can do drastically gets reduced. I love that I can do some of my scrapbooking during the long flights. I can recount my adventures and organize them in one place! It makes collages and organizes my pictures by date/location. Makes it easier to pinpoint pictures from different adventures. ❤

The only thing I don't like about Google photos is when I need access to a photo and I can't search for any because it's "organizing your photos so you can find them faster, try again later." Please stop organizing my photos, leave them on the date they were taken, and if I want to organize them, I should be able to do that myself by creating folders. I'm still a big Google fan, just not a big fan of not being able to access my photos quickly when I need to.

Excellent, much easier to use than the play store thankfully. Features are easy enough to find without getting frustrated. Its great to back up your photos and organise them and those albums. However, for some unknown reason, the "all photos" timeline is for some reason all mixed, such as a trip in July is labeled October with some split to the day after and other trips in there too. Another hitch is you can't turn off the camera auto backup, as I want full control over what I want to keep!!!

I really enjoy the videos and animations it automatically creates and suggests for me, as well as the memories from years ago it reminds me of. My photos are backed up and it's super easy to share albums with family and friends. One of my favorite things is the search. I can search for "hand writing" and it pulls up all the photos where I took a photo of some hand written notes, so I can search through for that photo of a Post-It I knew I took 6 months ago. The other day, my coworker asked if I had ever purchased the book cases I had talked about when I first bought my house. I knew I had taken a picture of them when I first got them, but it had been over a year ago. I searched for "bookcase" and was quickly able to find the photo. So cool

I absolutely hate the new editing updates. I love to edit photos, just casually, but it's SOOOO much harder than before. Like someone else said, if it ain't broke, don't fix it. Having to scroll through different grouped adjustments is annoying. I liked how it was before with every lighting and color adjustment being in the same place. I also hate that the perspective tool is gone. I was about to use it only to see I can't anymore. Now I need to see what other app I can use to edit photos.

It's great since I can back up my files. The downside is, the app is crashing whenever I click people and document album. It restarts every time. I can only use the photos category on the lower left corner after I subcribed for basic membership. I hope this can be fixed. It's hard to navigate with my photos and videos if this keeps on going. Might cancel my subscription if not fixed. I really thought subcribing on google one was worth the money. I hope you prove to me thatmy decision was right.

This application is a total disappointment!! I ordered 5 photo books which cost me $35 a piece. Not one of them came back with the right pictures and they were all wrong. There is no way to contact Google photo to let anyone know that they are wrong, so you just threw your money down a rat hole! I am so disappointed, I am so upset, this is terrible! Do not waste your money or spend your time buying their photo albums!

What happened to my vast collection of very precious photos? Your "updates" have removed the fun and trust out of the services we pay heavily for. I request every photo I ever put in the system be returned to my device....not at my expense. You are charging way too much for less service. I used to enjoy it, but now... i am not a happy customer. Thankyou for quickly returning ALL my personal treasured memory photos. phone

The storage alone is something to brag about, but this goes so far beyond that- it's insane! I bought a picture book of my pics and it is great! The app is so well designed. You can simply search the word flower and every picture you have with a flower comes up. You can basically give faces names so that you can search for a certain person in your photos. It documents your location where photos were taken and even makes short movies with your video clips and pictures. It's really awesome! I love Google Photos!

Some how many pictures have been lost! : ( it shows they have uploaded to Google photos but when I delete them from my device storage they are gone off Google too. Very upsetting. Also, selected photos to make an album....it said it was creating one....but than they were gone too!! Have to continue to purchase more storage every few months without it even giving any space! Customer service doesn't help. It's beyond frustrating! And a waste of money

Since the latest app update, the cropping tool no longer works in a useful way – I can't flip an aspect ratio from portrait to landscape anymore without rotating the whole image, and even when I do that, it doesn't maintain the aspect ratio I try and resize the area I want to crop. Might seem a small thing, but this was the feature I used most by a long way when editing photos since I don't care for filters or more advanced editing. I will have to look for an alternative.

Awesome, long time user. The only issue I have is that, because I've used this app for such a long time, I have A LOT OF ALBUMS, which is a headache when orgaizing pics. For some reason, in the app, when adding a pic to an album, it lists the albums in a weird algorithmic order which makes it really hard to find what youre lookin for. Only the last 3 you've modified show up on top of the list. Hoping to see that fixed!

I really like Google Photos, but I wish there was a way to view or recover my pictures based on the original folders they were saved in on my phone. Right now, all the photos are mixed together, and it’s hard to find things if I had them organized into folders before. Please add an option to keep or view photos by folder – it would make things so much easier for organizing and finding old pictures! thank you!

Fantastic app for storing your photo library! Especially on a Google Pixel with the unlimited photo uploads. Sharing photos and videos with friends and family couldn't be easier with the shared album feature, and I absolutely love how you can easily clear out my phone's storage with a tap of a button rather than guessing whether or not it is still using storage. My only issue is that you cannot change specific photos/videos to "high quality" from "original quality". It's either all or nothing.

Love Google Photos. The new version has some amazing search and catalogue features. I really can't understand why all but the most basic photo editing features were taken out? One step forward, two steps back.. EDIT: Some editing tools have been restored over the last few updates but still not everything that used to be in G+ version. Until then it's still just a photo repository rather than a one-stop 'Photos' app. Good, but could be even better.

Love the auto save feature that allows me to easily get to and download/ retrieve my photos... Unlike other major phones with built in cloud apps. Edit - 8/17/2022: So Google loves to make stylized photos, which is great, but if you don't look at them right away it's really hard/impossible to find out where they are hidden. Also sorting is not a possibility and the oldest will always be on top, so it takes a while to get to the newer items. Blech.

I wish there was a way to save some photos in their original quality and back-up the rest for free. Google photos has gotten progressively better and better. I love how easy it is to clear my phone memory (after photos are backed up) now. I like how organized it is. It's fairly easy to use and find the photos I want. The photo assistant (where it puts my photos/videos into collages, movies, and stories) is unnecessary, but it does make some fun animations!

Absolutely horrible update. It doesn't look cohesive and it's nearly impossible to find the basic "settings" - they're all re-named and spread out or missing completely. ("Utilities"? Really?) If you want to mess around with all these extra functions that most adults don't use, fine, but at least give us an understandable, familiar, easy-to-access slide out menu or three dots again. Quick and easy, which is what we want. This is awful. Oh and "edit" doesn't work on my LG G7 since update.

Perfect Perfect Perfect It's just getting better & better. Albums, clearing clutter, stylized photos, and it's all easier with a robot looking at every single one of the pictures you take and organizes them together. If your afraid of spying eyes... It's too late. Also! Google reserves the right to use any photo you take in their ads, it's in the terms of service (idk if people care or not). But I like this app and it makes life easy and that's the whole point of Google.

Another great Google app. and I must use it if not daily, many times every week. But, I do wish it was still connected to Google Drive, or was integrated in some way. It would be much easier to store and find photos and the many other things I save. Why did Google separate the two apps? Anyway, Google Photos is an excellent App. and it's a joy to use. I very rarely have any software issues, and I've never lost any of my photos. It definitely gets 5 stars from me!

I love most of the features, but I have 3 suggestions: 1. Allow the user to change pictures in the auto-created collages. Sometimes the collage just has one bad picture, but there is no option to change it. 2. The user should be able to order a photo book from an album they created. Instead, I have to use a 3rd party to order my photo books. 3. Get rid of the music on memories. Yes, I can click to turn it off, but then it also turns off the audio for videos.

Ehhhh... It would be really nice and 1000% useful if pictures were saved to albums in photos. So if you want to have prints made of several pictures but you cropped and enhanced but Photos puts "folder" pics all out of order if they aren't in your camera roll. It's lame and I would just assume use Onedrive and Amazon Photos cause they both have that very super technical, mega advanced, futuristic feature but Google doesn't. C'mon now!

It's a really good app and it's really useful and I can also count on it that all my pictures and videos will get backed up but the only problem is that once I delete my pics and videos from my gallery the videos that were backed up lose quality. They look a little blurry and they looked way better when they were on mu gallery and not the app. So please fix that and yes I have it set to back up high quality and unlimited storage but they still don't look that good.

Google is all over the place doin everything and im a big fan of Google photos. So easy to use and great filters for editing. However, I feel it would be even better if it also offered an easier way to organize my photos and movies and even better would be if I was able to use Google photos to search for all my duplicates and delete them. Ive got lots of duplicates but don't have the time go thru my entire library. Just a suggestion.

I take a gazillion photos to record my journey #OffTheGridLive for my family, friends and future. Photos are a must-have to expedite the process. I almost always use Google photos to edit my work. It offers a good selection of options to fine-tune my pics. For basic stuff it works fine. When it comes to storage, it promises a lot. I have multiple accounts which gets confusing at times. I would Def recommend that you organize your work to make finding it more user-friendly. Overall, well done.

I tap "Library" at the bottom of the screen. Then I open any folder with pictures, open any picture. There's no star button to favourite the picture. When I tap "Photos" at the bottom of the screen, and then open a photo, there's a 🌟 button on the top of the screen, however most of the photos on my device cannot be found in the "Photos" view. A completely useless feature! In general, I also find the concept of "Photos" vs. "Library" very confusing and annoying.

So buggy! There is a huge "lag" on things like comments. For example: you'll get a push notification saying someone commented on a photo, but when you go to the feed, it's not there. Maybe it'll show up by the next day if you're lucky. It's also kind of hard to figure out how to select and add photos to/ from your different albums. If they could work on these issues it would be perfect.

The most amazing way to store your photos! It is so easy to find previously taken pics!! You can search photos by location, thing, holiday, person, month or year!! It recognizes faces and creates folders for each person. If I want to make a collage of my kids, I can easily bring up every photo that has my kids in it. People are always impressed with how quick I can find a pic that was taken years ago! Best app ever!!

Terrible app. There is no mass camera roll, instead the default storage of photos is by date, which just looks and feels more unorganized. Counterintuitive I know, but it's true. Photos taken in airplane mode just default to a random date, meaning you can't find them very easily when you want to see them, and obviously they aren't in the correct chronology of when you took them. Automatically creates random photo folders without adding those photos to your camera roll. 1 star do not recommend.

Two main grudges at present. With thousands of photos it is virtually impossible to organise them without extremely tedious efforts. No way to select photos that are NOT in any album, so you are left with lots of "orphans" - very frustrating. Secondly, and related, is the lack of a two or more tier structure to store albums. You end up with either countless smaller albums, or fewer albums with countless photos in each. Not good :-{ However, there are many great features overall, granted :-)

Another Gallery app that spoon-feeds photo organization by what THEY want - by date. Give me a gallery that simply displays my photos the way I have organized them - in directories, IN ALPHABETICAL ORDER, nothing more !! Google programmers can't seem to be able to do a simple array. What I see is a random list of directories, not based on any alphabet known to man, making it impossible to find a photo. Your AI search is useless in searching for abstracted photos, etc.

The functionality of this app is better than most photo apps. However, managing photos would be easier if creating an album and putting pictures in to said album then took them out of your camera roll. I like the idea of an album being locked so the contents are secure, say, for example if a child was to play with your phone. Are these things possible to implement?

I absolutely love Google Photos. I have used this app for years and would never go anywhere else for app to store my photos. It keeps them organized, and frees up my phone. All the categories and options are great. My favorite part is that Google occasionally makes these REALLY GREAT clips, videos, and collages with your photos. Adds music and all sorts of things to them. All this for free? Bet!

It may just be me, and that's fine, but I'm completely lost with Google photos. I just got the new BlackBerry Priv and overall I've been very happy with it, with the exception of Google photos. BlackBerry - you're partially to blame for this too. Whether it's my memory card or settings that I can't figure out how to change, whenever I download photos from Facebook or Twitter, etc they don't go into my photos folder. I have no clue where they are. For a long time BlackBerry user, this is overly difficult

The app is fine, but their help center is absolute garbage. I ordered 80 photos, and they were delivered to the wrong address, so I went onto the website to try and sort out the issue, get them replaced or refunded, I'm a pretty chill human being, and their so called "help center" just took me in circles, telling me to go to this, click here, and then do this, which would just bring me back to the page that told me to do that. at the end of the day, I still have 0 clue where the photos I ordered are, and I can't get ahold of anyone to help me find them.

Pros: intuitive, direct and free storage within Google network, face label, albums, photo scanning, stylized cool pics, grouped memory collages Cons: not enough photo editing capabilities, wish it was easier to tag a person in a photo, need more photo editing from within app. between the pixel 3xl and the Google photos we should be able to do it all, but especially blemishes, smiles, red eyes, scenery, let's make it easy to show what this camera can do in fogg or in the rain.

Mostly good, but wish better organizing. Features missing, such as After archiving pics from main bucket, to be able to share pics in albums, that were archived in main view bucket. Actually better, would be able to select pics & "move" them into an album, like Google Drive can do. Take them out of the main view, as I call the primary/main bucket. Very cluttered; can't remember which pics I've already put into albums.... very annoying 😒.

Since the last update photos taken with the Phone camera will show normally for about a second, then automatically boost the light sources in the picture. I could not find a way to turn this "feature" off. While some photos might look better with the "enhancement", the big issue is that the photos you see in the photos app will be very different than the same photos you share on another app. Please give users a way to disable this nonsense, or turn it into a tool in the image editor.

it's great at backing up photos. But when trying to delete large number of photos, you have to select in groups (as you cannot select all, even with scrolling). With large number of photos, this is a pain and takes way too much time. In one forum I found you have to search (in my case, search by year) and then select those photos to delete. Could improve on managing storage. They seem to want to push you into paying for more cloud storage.

I pay 1.99 to this app & I also use one drive also 1.99. Very similar, which is better? Depends on your device. I still use Windows Phones for my kids. I find i can limit a little more. But Photo, has a app known as PhotoScan, which makes perfect pics of items your wanting to share. Documents etc. However, if you use office- one drive is linked to your account and makes it easier for pc. So, i do both. Sometimes you can find yearly specials, its worth it. I personally prefer to get year specials.

I really like the automatic backup and unlimited photo storage. It has been great switching from iPhone to Android a few times over the past few years. My only beef, is that often when I try to upload photos to an album it will not save or keep the album with all of the images in it. I've tried updating the app, changing around certain settings and nothing seems to work, so that aspect of the albums is a hit or miss and can be somewhat frustrating at times.

I love the app and almost everything from Google. Two things that would make it better are more photo editing tools with a huge variety of options like a lot of the other photo editor apps. Also, the ability to lock certain albums with a passcode and a generic cover photo, just in case someone gets access to your phone or tablet etc and there is certain pictures youd rather them not see. Add those two things please!

Easy to use, and I love how it brings up your memories. My original review is from 2016 which tells you I've been using it for a long time. Over the years of course they've tried to improve the app which has been a hit or miss. Sometimes it will automatically upload folders from your device that you have not selected to be uploaded which makes it frustrating because it removes it from your app once it uploads to the storage. Overall I still heavily use this app and still recommend it

Photos was once a 5 star app, until you totally broke sharing. It shouldn't be so hard to share multiple photos simultaneously to apps like Instagram. It shouldn't be so hard for pictures shared back and forth between Pixel users to show up in the photos gallery available for sharing regardless of who's device captured the original photo, that's kind of the point. Please make Photos (the default Pixel Gallery app) suck less. Please fix this!

You can do some really cool things with your pics with this app. I actually really love the suggestions they throw out at you periodically. They suggest fun animations and collages. They create books that you can edit and buy. I never would have thought to do that, and of course, I have to edit some pics to get these books just the way I want them, but it's cool that they suggest it and throw out ideas. Also, I like the "remember when," where they show you pics from years ago. Great to reminisce

Love this app! Automatically uploads all of my pictures and videos. Keeps me organized. Keeps my phone clean and free of clutter. And, the assistant reminds you of memories from years ago to look back on from that day. That's probably one of my favorite features! You can organize yourself even further by creating albums to put all your uploaded pics & videos into. (I think there's a way to purchase them too!) The best part, once uploaded, you can view them from ALL of your devices!

Absolutely love Google Photos. You can customise so much in the app, & I'm always finding new things to do. You can use the magic eraser to remove something in the photo you don't like (like the mother-in-law! Lol), which is a great feature. You can create movies from photos & videos or just a lovely collage. You can also order photo books too, either in paperback or hardback. This review & features available are based on my Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra. Features may be different on other phones.

Needs improvements- I've wasted like 2 hours of my life trying to create a "movie", but the app crashes after about an hour. You have to hand-select photos or videos to add, so if your library is large, it's cumbersome and very frustrating when lost. Secondly, while scrolling through main library of photos on my phone, I like to put them into folders. The folders are ordered chronologically instead of alphabetically, so if you have more than 50+ folders, it's tedious to find the one you want.

I hate this app with a burning passion!!! The album's you create manually don't show up in other apps, not all of my photos are saved, and even when I delete stuff it comes back! The app has so many damn annoying and unnecessary features and the worst part is I can't delete it!! If I could give it negative stars I would! I just want a simple gallery app, damn!!!

After spending hours of organizing photos on my phone, I turned to google photos to organize my backup photos in the same way using albums. While you can add albums to google photos, the photos in the albums show up in photos tab as well all organized by the date the photo was taken, which makes it difficult to determine what photos are already in albums. Ideally under the photo tab I would like to see all the albums I have and then the photos that have yet to be added into an album. I ended up backing all my photos on a hard drive and deleting all my photos from the app, it just seems too overwhelming to organize photos on my phone as well as the app. I did appreciate that the app did not let you delete photos from your SD card without permission, however I did notice on the site if you deleted a photo that was on the SD card, it continues to show up on the app, but not the website which creates a disconnect from the app and site, creating an even more overwhelming experience when trying to organize photos.

UX has gotten progressively worse over time. It has become difficult to see where some of the automagically generated images (e.g. then and now, collages, etc.) are located after they pop up. Take for example the pop up, "New Version Available" when there is no new version available. I appreciate the app, but whomever is leading the product is leading it off of a cliff.

I take care I photos I shoot and backup. The app suddenly stopped uploading full quality images, failed to inform me of this change, causing hundreds of shoots to be uploaded ("high quality") small and pixelated and then deleted them all ("Free Up Space"). They informed me after, I now I have to pay to recieve my original photos. That is so greedy and unethical. Often spend a long time creating shared albums to get an error at the end. "Try again later". Only works on my PC from what I gather.

It's a really amazing app making videos appear with the repetition like tiktok. Although I had some saved videos a while ago and all of a sudden they disappeared from my home page, but if I were to log into my account on a pc they would show. Don't know why that was so...but I would like for it to be checked. All in all it's wonderful. Thanks Google!

Best app ever. Keeps absolutely every image and video backed up. Unlimited storage, everything in chronological order. You can search by key words of what is in the picture , from colors, to items, etc. And it will come up for the most part. It's amazing. Then the image animations , or collages and so much more that it puts together for you. It's truly an amazing app. Whether you're an iphone or Android user , we can ALL benefit greatly from this app.

WHY is there not an option to retain device albums. I organize my photos my MY system and there will never be an algorithm that can possibly understand the difference between some categories. this is APPALLINGLY arrogant product design when it would be so simple to implement. Best photo app out there. The categories are amazing, you can make albums for different people and pets. Great facial recognition! It catches the cats even, and people over the years. How it knows what I looked like as a baby I don't know! I'm very pleased with this app, and we use it as a family so everyone's photos go into one account and we can sort through there. Easy to sort. Stupid stupid photo app. I hate this thing. There's no way to organize your photos and God forbid you take a portrait photo! It will store every. single. photo. in a separate folder. Weirdly slow and annoying music in the memories. When looking through my gallery, it takes a while to load the thumbnails, even though the photos are all on my phone. Using the native gallery App shows all instantly. This makes browsing the photos a huge chore. Additionally, please allow muting the music during memories and other reels. I just want to be able to see and hear my videos and photos. It makes it very distracting, and sometimes the music is not appropriate for the context.

Best photo app, easy to create albums and share it with the family. The storage plan is great and can be shared with other family member. Some gadget features like album automation or albums from few years ago are a very nice touch. The map is also a very nice way to explore the photos. Love the sync feature above all, kudos and great job for the team working on it.

Updated version (2025) NO, NO, NO, we didn't ask for a new editing interface and do not want it!! WHERE is the option to crop photos by one corner at a time, to change perspective?!? Whose terrible idea was this?!? 🤬

It's pretty good. Google banks on money spent for photo storage, so there is no incentive for them to do so, but a duplicate finder for past photos would be immensely helpful. Without it, I'm stuck combing through thousands of photos to delete the duplicates and triplicates I can find. Also, not sure what has glitched in their system recently, but many of the facial tags got mixed up in my account. Irritating and time consuming to fix. Otherwise, pretty good.

Great for backing up and sharing. I appreciate the updates to the app over the years. The backup feature has been reliable and I love the ability to back up photos across multiple devices to one account. I really like the sharing features and have been able to share photos to loved ones during this past year of COVID-19 lockdown. One feature I wish we could have is the ability to export the entire album (sort order, comments and inline album text) and not just the photos.

Had always worked as required but now will not open. It tries to start up but crashes every time. Also, how difficult would it be to make the link the developer replied with clickable? Or selectable so I could copy and paste it to the browser on my phone? Having to flip between apps whilst trying to remember a seemingly random series of letters and numbers doesn't help with the frustration. If there is already a way for me to do this easily, it's not obvious to an old geezer like me.

Has worked excellent in the past, however, recently, it has not been backing up any photos and says that all photos have already been backed up, which just isn't the case. Long overdue edit; The issue was my phone, so some reason it was just neglecting to work at all for literally anything. Since getting a different phone will say that the app is still amazing. Love that I can add in people and pets names, then type in their name in the search bar and only their pictures shows up.

If you want this app to backup your photos, there are better ways. If your photos are organized in folders, backup does not preserve your folders. Instead, you have thousands of photos all together. If you ever have to restore them from the backup, you will have to sort them out one by one! That means creating new folders on your device, finding each photo individually, then adding them to your newly created device folders. Believe me or not.

I've had a pretty good experience through the years... Until now. Even though I really don't utilize Google Photos very often I was just shown the latest tweeks and updates so I am intuitive on changing that. I know the assistant isn't a Newbie but very helpful. Extremely difficult to use. There is no function to "move" a picture into an album! The app is being more and more strict about making a user switch to cloud. To download a set of backed up photos on phone, you can only do it one by one. I spent last 2 hours figuring out how to do it, but they have already made life so much harder. Looking for another app to manage photos from now on.

I think it's awesome to have free unlimited high quality compressed photo backups. I also love the automatic effects. Sometimes it randomly makes an animation out of your photos, other times it's a slideshow with music. I just like being surprised by these little extras when they happen. The auto adjust feature is pretty good. I often use it first and then adjust the settings more myself and find that it's quite a bit faster than doing it all from scratch.

After reading other reviews I see I'm not alone in some of my frustration with the app. For the most part I truly enjoy it but I'm waiting like patience on a monument over here for pictures I need that were snapped with my phone or tablet camera to upload. I'd like to be able to label or name my photos easier too. Why can't we organize gifs quicker & easier? Dates are good but names/labels would be easier. When I need a picture I need to know I can quickly & easily locate it and move on.

Photos in albums are put there to organize and reduce clutter, yet duplicates are still there in the main pool which still leaves the main pool cluttered and confusing. Photos in albums shouldn't be displayed in the main pool because you can find them in their respective album. Photos in albums should retain their date and place shot of course.

Great to be able to access my phone photos from any device. Update - 5 years on: I've now got 1000s of photos & upgraded to paid storage. The most frustrating thing is not being able to find what I need. I have a mixture of personal & business photos (so many cakes!) I would love to be able to tag the photos so I can easily find a specific cake - for example #coffee #cake #birthday #2x8". However the only way to add that info is in the description & that's useless as it isn't searchable 😣

I was using my phone gallery for photos, but this offers a lot of features that I find myself using more and more. I love the way it sorts faces and you can name them and then just search for the person or animal (yes, animals!) that you want to find pictures of. I took a group photo at work with around 40 people and it added each face in the photo. I couldn't believe it. Pretty amazing Google! Now if you could just add something to color my black and white photos. That'd be awesome!

You can't put photos into folders like you used to be able to. I have hundreds of thousands of pictures. How am I supposed to organize them? They are completely and totally unmanageable. If your photos are in albums on your phone, they'll be dumped into one location when they're uploaded. If you want to scroll back to like 2016 it will take about 45 minutes, IF you don't accidentally click back to today's date. You can't organize your photos in Drive anymore, either. They said that was too confusing. They could have added an advanced "View Photos in Drive" toggle to let superusers turn that feature on so we could easily move photos into folders, but they don't want you to be able to move your photos to a new service easily. It worked. I wish I'd used literally any other service. I hate Google Photos

I have loved this app, having used it for about 7 years now. I have saved literally thousands of photos, and organized them into albums. The only negative about it is that when I changed my email address, thousands of photos and all of my albums disappeared. I later found them, after finding how to go into the app under my old email address. Would be great if you could merge the two

Hands down the best photo service currently amongst icloud, Dropbox, amazon etc. Just works. It's even better if you take pics from multiple devices they all show up in the same place. Assistant is good too, but is more of a me too feature. Good basic editing features too. And many more that most users will never use. The sharing feature ie album sharing could do some more work. It's very confusing right now and not straightforward. It doesn't need to be so. The only other ask is to allow high res / original quality uploads. Highly recommended. Boo on Apple for not even coming close and asking so much money to do basic sync of photos across devices.

Don't order prints! There's no way to get help when you're order is messed up or MISSING. Part of my order never showed it was even shipped out! It's pretty basic. I do like the tools and filters available for free as well as the ones you have to pay for. The price is low, however it irritates me that Google (being the billionaires that they are) decided to charge their loyal customers for certain features within the photos app. I find it to be unnecessary as they make PLENTY of money already thru so many other things, they could have just let it all be free. Love it but there are things I don't quite understand. Albums: there's has to be sorting options. You can only see the photos chronologically. I have shared albums with my family. I love using gphotos. I am not an advanced user... just someone who has a phone with very little storage, so the ability to automatically store in the cloud is critical. I've tried to use albums for this purpose, but it's not meant for that and gets too difficult to manage as the number of albums increases.

I was hoping that the Googles Photos App had some easy option to both preserve our memories in two ways. (Maybe I missed some kind of option when exploring the settings..idk...) ...but.. It's not that difficult to just put a "recent" tab that actually includes all the photos on your device.

The latest update is terrible. Significantly more difficult to access my library. It was so much user friendly the way it was! Edit: It isn't that I'm incapable of figuring it out. I did. Far less easy to find what I want on the go as my folders are now several prompts away.

Google photos is a great app! It captures the most memorable times of my life. The assistant keeps my photos in order by date and it even gives me the option to create different albums,books, collages, and much more! It even keeps track of my phone's storage and will archive photos, get rid of duplicates, and other unnecessary materials. It is by far the best app to use and trust that your memories will be kept alive for many years to come. 5+ stars!

I have really liked the app, so far! The auto-animations, collages, and filters are generally pretty good. And honestly, I wouldn't end up making them myself... So for Google to make them for me is great. Collecting images by face is great, too. Even for pets! I just wish I was better at getting old photos included in the app so it could go through those as well.

Edit: this app has gone downhill. It has now screwed up the dates and order of my photos. Everything is 1 year or 6 months ahead or behind. It's impossible to look for specific photos now because the dates are so messed up. And for some reason it keeps trying to back up photos that have been already backed up 4 months ago. I have not move/relocated any folders for this occur. And the storage is a horrendous pain. I cannot delete stuff without it intrusively trying to delete it off my device.

After a while of looking through a search or an album, tapping on a photo takes you to the wrong photo. And the miniscule space allocation makes it useless.

I'm a long-time Picasa user, so I was upset to hear that Google would no longer be updating that program, but Photos is a suitable replacement. Currently, you can only do a search from your main photo library. Also, you can scroll through your main photo library by date, but this is not the case in your albums. Please add these features!

Great app. Backs up my photos on my phone. I can view them anyplace and I never need to manage it. Google automatically creates special albums, and enhanced photos that I can further modify. This app is maybe the most amazing I've ever seen. The collages, movies and slide shows it generates are wonderful, and I can search my photos for the most vague topics, and by golly, it finds them. Trees. Flowers. Peoples names. Locations. Cats. Thank you Google! Keep up the GREAT work! 2019 update... Google Photos continually improving! I only have one complaint... when i upgraded to saving my photos in original resolution, google doesnt provide a way to re-upload photos.

Poor app for anything other than backing the photos. Simple sharing doesn't work; when I try to upload to Instagram, I can only send a direct message with a link or a shared album. Love, love, love this app! So many great features! You can easily group photos together by people, places, things, selfies, etc. Makes it so much easier to find that photo that you're looking for. And you can even make a photo book! I plan on using this in the very near future with Mother's Day and Father's Day coming up. It doesn't have to be a commercial holiday to make one. It's great for scrapbooking, organizing your photos, and various edits.

I no longer fear losing my phone with photo backup, which is worth this app just for that. I love pretty much everything about this app, and my criticisms are mostly nits. First, I wish I had options to sort my albums (by name, by date, last modified, created, etc). Second, a huge improvement would be around editing photos: being able to save as copy or keep the changes in history, easier one click rotation, especially for photos that are not on the phone's physical storage.

I wish you could search for an album name when trying to add photos--rather than having to scroll through ALL of them, in chronological order--trying to find the album you want to add pics to! I end up with multiple copies of albums just because it's easy to scroll past the one you want, and/or it's taking too long to find the one you want!

Sorting and searching options are good. However, I just want my photos to show up from most recent. I used to could select the library option, then select the screenshots, camera roll, downloaded, or whatever. Now its complicated and not worth my time. Working horribly now... App crashing a lot working with new album I created. It has many photos, but still very much below limit of 2000. I want to be able to do the things I did in my i-phone, prior to switching to Android. I could briefly check my photos on a daily basis on my phone and quickly move them to various photo albums. Photo sharing issues between my Mac, iPad and Android phone are extremely frustrating and annoying as I can't sync them with my phone any more so have two separate and different photo libraries.

I expect more from Google, but it's okay I guess. This app is good, but lacks features. The huge feature that's missing is the ability to hide/lock photos/albums. I really love this app. It gives me the opportunity to have all my photos in one place where I can access them over multiple devices, which is a BIG help for me. Love this app. All of my electronics have this app on them and they all sync together. I have over 5,000 pics/videos stored there. I can ho anywhere and retrieve them as long as I can log into Google. Thank you Google for making my memories last.

Also, ways to sort photos within folders are limited There is no option for name, size, file type. Biggest annoyance - when you scroll through individual photos and then go back, it takes you back to the first picture you picked instead of where you swiped to - why?!?!?

Even with backup is turned off, it will still backup your pictures and videos. Terrible update. I don't want to be forced to use a documents photo album. The UI is a bit confusing and not so friendly. Very good and fast. Duplicate checking is incredible. Honestly, I'm impressed with the app. The main reason I downloaded it was for the backup and flexibility of that feature. The stylized photos the app creates are amazing. As far as printing an image is concerned, I imagine if you can share to a printer, it should work. Aside from that, I could not find a print function, but I do not have a printer driver & printer installed.

It works well enough as a camera roll app. But there are some quality of life changes I'd like to see. Like being able to select more than one photo at a time to download to my device. I also get very, very tired of the constant ads in the app to order printed photos, get photo albums, etc. I really don't appreciate being advertised to in a core app on my phone and would very much like if the interface was streamlined more and those ads were cut.

Its free 1st of all, so there's nothing to lose. On top of that "Photos" has really set the bar high for any other app like this (which there are none) to compete. Upload, sync, download, automated editing & sorting across all devices. Pretty amazing. The search function is unreal! If you take pictures & have kids this app is priceless. By far Google's best app & it's only gotten better over the years.

Not very customizable. I dislike that I can't turn dates off, I don't want to see my photos grouped by the date they were taken, I should have the ability to turn that off. Love Google photos. Especially when I take 3 photos in a panning shot and it stitches them together in a panoramic shot.
