UPDATED REVIEW: I've used this app for years now. It manages to store & organize my pictures without losing them. My house burnt down awhile ago. I lost many [physical] photographs as a result of water damage. Due to Google Photos, I have pictures I wouldn't have had beforehand. However, I made a huge mistake. I thought I backed up everything from the home computer which melted in the fire. I lost years of pictorial memories, as I didn't back them up. Lesson Learned!

Not at all what I thought it was. I downloaded this after Google image search stopped letting me save directly off of the search, thinking Photos would solve that issue. That's not the case here. My phone's gallery app works just fine. I don't need Google to be a data cloud, fully knowing that my images are being used for other data-gathering purposes. There are better clouds for that. No thank you.

Poor. The Album function displays photos in random sequence, not in the order I choose, and removes photos from the album when I try to rearrange them. I've reported this issue to Google repeatedly, to no avail. Another issue: there used to be a way to starred photos as "Favorites" but that feature appears to be gone and all the photos I had starred as "Favorites" are no longer so. There are other issues but these two are the most serious ones for me Seeking alternatives to this product.

Bad UX. Saved a modified version of a not-so-recent photo from an album? Good luck finding it ever again in the whole feed. Trying to export a photo to another folder so that it's easier to find in other apps? You can't. Upload dialog blocking UI waiting for network? Tough luck, now you can't use the app until you have network again or kill it. Can't add selection of photos to more than one album. Can't see what albums a photo is already part of.

The auto-upload photo storage is wonderful. The AI adds a lot of searchability but can be inconsistent about faces. Most troublesome is that if Google fails to see a face where one is, there is no option to highlight and name the person. Also, when I say that a face is not who they think it is, I'd like to be prompted to give the correct name, rather than it just untagging the face.

I instantly, regret, paying for storage, just to see how bad this is when it comes to selecting photos and overall systems compared to the actual gallery from the original device. I got no time to select one by one randomly, and the thing is, when I tried to copy my photos from my album to this app, it turns out the folder placed in my internal device, not the app, that now, all the date of the photos are messed up. Change your systems, it's complicated and disappointing.

I love this app. My phone doesn't have a regular photo gallery, so I didn't have much of a choice, but I was pleasantly surprised. I do, however wish they had more editing options for my photos & videos. The unlimited storage is wonderful & allows me take all the photos & videos I like, without fear of running out of space to keep them. The assistant is a nice feature that most other apps lack & it's pretty helpful too. Plus, it allows me to easily share pics & videos with my family & friends.

I just used the option to free up space and now the app it's just a mess of unorganized photos sorted by date only. I'd like to have the option to at least create albums that automatically fill with pics from a certain device folder so I don't have to deal with this mess. I like my photos organized by decice folder but albums olny let me fill them automatically with photos of certain people or pets.

This is just poor and i can't believe i thought this was the answer to my problems, far from it! Sync doesn't work, just hangs with the following messages: - getting photos OR - getting ready to backup Also, app doesn't find my photo folders half the time. tried everything from a reinstall to clear data/cache but nothing works. sharing? pointless if i can't get my photos in the cloud to begin with and seems like Google don't care from a lot of what I've read about others having similar issues.

This app used to be really good and helpful with storing all my photos, and I quite liked the "on this day" bit back in time. But now with the stupid "remember this day" and it was like two days ago, er of course I remember that day! For me it chooses to show me what happened a few days ago or earlier this month, I don't need to see that, I took the photos I should remember it! The old app with the previous years was better, please consider taking it back to the easier simple version.

Great app! Very easy to synchronize between cell phone and laptop. I value how this app organizes photos for you based on location, features (e.g. mountains, lakes and cities), allows you to bulk-rotate photos and offers easily stylized photos. You can also create shared albums. Perhaps the most important feature is the free storage. I highly reccomend this app.

Google photos is amazing. The app never crashes. Automatic upload of all my photos. Super cheap and well worth it to upgrade and add extra storage. The fact that it recognizes faces (I can save the names of everyone in my photos) and I can search for literally anything and it'll find it is hands down the most convenient and mind blowing aspect. I can type in chicken and it finds all my chicken photos!!

I don't use this app for backup. You'd be crazy to only trust a cloud backup. I use it for the insane AI and sorting. I can find any picture that is on here by just using a few key words or a person's name. I never have to guess the date, the place, or anything. I can search for "car" and all of my pictures with cars in them show up. It's great for sharing photos of shared events with other users. You can just add their entire album they made to your library, to fill the event from another view.

Best gallery app ever! But don't sell it short, it's so much more than a simple gallery. I never have to worry about losing photos as they are automatically backed up. In addition, my wife and I automatically share photos of our son between us! The facial recognition is spot on and I never miss a moment when I'm at work. Thanks to Google for designing a superior product!!

Ok,how about this. Not sure why I have to update the storage device for my pictures. Also I like to be able put my folders in a specific order, not brought to the front when it gets new pictures added. The more I have to update the less space I have on my phone. Seems dumb. Also, I don't need a reminder that I'm "missing out" when I just wanna look at my pictures.

I hate that it sorts all your pictures into four folders and there is no way to merge them, meaning if I need to find something I was sent and saved I need to go through several different folders to try to find it, since they go in a different folder depending on the app you saved it from. Extremely annoying.

All in all not a bad app BUT, and there's always a but 1. When I make a collage I'd like to pick from a few different templates to show off these photos. It's all the same even with different photos. I want to choose where to put them and how big each photo can/should be. After all they're my memories. 2. When I try to write on the pics in the editor part, you can't see the writing. What's the sense of having that option if it's absolutely useless. Once these are fixed I'll change my rating.

Great place to store all my photos and memories. Easily separate personal photos from saved memes or sayings off the net. I have had a hard time as of late getting it to recognize new faces. The faces it does know has incomplete lists of photos and albums. I also see no way to revoke shared album privileges more or less control who can see it to just those invited. I would say it is a good work in progress but is without many much needed features.

I'm SO thankful that you guys final allow us to sort our albums by title instead of last photo taken date. Ugh. Now PLEASE do a setting "delete from device and archive". At the very least bring back the ability to leave things "selected" until we unselected them, it use to be that way. Right now I have to "select photos" then "delete photos from device" then I have to go "select photos" again, then "archive". This process is even worse if I decide to do this before photos has backed up

I love the layout of this app. It's easy to find pictures, create albums, order prints, and the facial recognition is great. But there have been ongoing issues/bugs with the editing. So many photos can't be edited because a pop-up says I have poor connection. I don't understand why I need any connection just to edit. I HAVE good service/internet so it makes no sense. I also have cropped photos which can't be reverted back even though the app says they can. It is frustrating.

This app is just great. It backs up my photos from my phone onto my Google account , so I can access my photos anywhere. It also allows me to clear up space on my phone. There are some really cool features such as: 1. Being able to make physical photo books, canvas prints and normal prints 2. Being able to create collages, animations and slideshows 3. It can sort people using facial recondition and sorting them into folders Overall it is a necessity for anyone who likes photos.

App is set up in a very frustrating way that makes it hard to find pictures. Samsung photos was so much better. And stop trying to force me to back up my photos! I don't want to, stop making me click multiple times every few days to stay that I still don't want to! Not to mention it's set up to get you to inadvertantly turn it on. Just stop! I will never turn on notifications or backup, and that is my choice and my right. Stop bombarding me to try and force me to or wear me down! NO MEANS NO!

Will not let me use the app without keeping it updated. I can't even look at a picture, there's no option to close the splash page. Had to download a new app because I was at the lake trying to show my friend a picture and I couldn't because the app wasn't updated, and we didn't have service. I suggest "simple photo gallery" as a replacement.

The app works great. But when it recommends to you to back up photos from your gallery to Google photos it does NOT mention it deleting them from your device. I know me and a lot of other people have had the same experience. If you want those photos back, you have to INDIVIDUALLY download each one which is BIZARRE. How can you not select many to save to your device at once? Then you have to put in a lot of unnecessary effort just to get the pictures back on ur device. Good app but fix this pls.

I love this app. I rely on it my entire life. I would like to make a suggestion. Can you please add a search feature to look for a specific album name when adding photos. I have many albums. So it takes long time to scroll down a list of albums when you want to add photos to a specific album. Im sure the users need that feature too. Please make it happen 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 I would give 5 stars if you make it happen.

Not happy at all about discontinuing unlimited storage. I may have to find an alternative. Also, being able to change the orientation of all photos at once instead of sporadically when Google photos notices it works be great. I like that I can label and create folders, find pics by faces, month, year, event, and location. Creating a link to share many videos and photos and awesome and fast. I like the memories, and collages and videos it creates too.

It doesn't let you edit collages at all. If you want to have the pictures swap places or if something got cropped out, too bad, you can't fix it. Also, you can't choose how your albums are organized, they will always be organized by most recent. So if the last thing you took a picture of or saved was something you don't want anyone to accidently see, too bad, it's going to be at the top of your list of albums.

I wish that I could give this app zero stars. It's functional, and it backs up your photos if you tell it to, but it doesn't back up the folders they were in. When photos are backed up, they can only ever be organized by date, and not by the folders you spent hours organizing. There is no way to get the folders back. You must give up, or download each photo individually (let us do it in bulk!) and then organize them all again. The "Free up space" option should have so many warnings. It has none.

Nothing is organized. My photos are not in order. I have photos from months and years all listed under the same day. Some stuff I download goes to my photo roll while some of it goes to a folder. When I save a picture from a text it says it's saved in the messages album, which would be fine if that album existed in the first place. It doesn't. I hate the app. I don't even write reviews on apps I actually like but never have I hated an app so much. Do yourself a favor and don't get this one.

Best option I've seen for photo organization on Android. I wish it was possible to sort based on file size and if a photo is original size or optimized. Easier sorting would also be nice for those of us who have thousands of photos but still need them in a chronological order. The scroll speed should allow more control. As it is I start scrolling through days and suddenly I'm skipping years. It's also a shame Snapseed controls aren't built-in to Google Photos (perhaps as an advanced option). This also needs to show patch notes so we know what changed on each release.

Automatically moves photos to albums, then can't find them. Ridiculous. Google is dropping the ball in the software development dept, launching before suitable testing in multiple areas. This is one of them. Edit: 10/20/20 - worse than ever. STOP MOVING MY PHOTOS TO A FOLDER/WHEREVER YOU THINK THEY SHOULD FIT. THANKS MY JOB, NOT YOURS.

The new editing interface is trash. I do not care about, nor do I want automatic editing suggestions. The layout is less intuitive than it used to be. And as a bonus, for the life of me I can no longer find how I'm supposed to edit foreground and background blur independently for shots taken in portrait mode, when that used to be a simple thing to do. Stop breaking what used to work Google.

I have been trying to download this update for two full days and it will not go through. I actually went to sleep last night and woke up 7 hours later still with it going in circles trying to get through the update. I'm updating it this morning two times . Do you have any advice on how to get this loaded to my phone if it's not taking it. Very frustrating and time consuming with no results!!!

This app is not trustworthy. Failing to upload pictures and albums and a very messy gallery. Rarely the actual date of the picture is the same as the date on the gallery, finding myself looking around all the gallery for what I'm looking for. Years ago Google Photos was working properly and just lately (around one year) it got too much messy.

This app is usually pretty good, but recent updates have hidden a lot of my favourite features away without a way to access them. For example, there used to be an entire section for "suggested for you" which kept the automatically created collages, animations, and stylised photos in one spot that was easy to access. Now, if I dismiss a notification for an automatic creation, I'll probably never find it again.

This has been my go-to app for photos for a long time, so I'm pretty invested in it. I'm always amused by the auto-generated stylized photos. But I really dislike the new Android updates (starting when - I don't know). I try to check out whatever notification and only ever get a photo scroll that I can't stop or start from the beginning. Super frustrating. Please get rid of the photo scroll. My personal photos are Not an instagram story. I will never want them to be.

Update Jan 21, 2025: Increasing my rating as Google listened and added a pet face feature! Still want to tag my cat in more pics, but it's getting better. They also made it easier to rename or at least describe photos and that's important for search. I still don't like the "feature" where you only have 1 copy of a pic. For an artist, I need to have slightly different versions of the same photo in multiple places and delete from a folder, but not all devices. Bad:Timestamps can cause lost photos.

Especially love the sharing options. Can also easily pull into Snapseed (maybe other edit apps like Lr too). Smart functions like suggested rotate, free up space, and clear the clutter/archive are just a few (one or two) clicks away. Update to be able to add portrait blur to any photo is pretty sick. Not gonna lie, have run into various small glitches like lag between photos taken and visible in albums. Time stamping is sometimes off. But they're rare and usually get fixed quickly. Ty Google!

I'm really enjoying the app, it's amazing. I just have a suggestion, if you guys can modify so I can browse my backed up photos in folders, just as I backed it up! If you can include it as an option apart from grouping the pictures. This will really save a lot of time I spend searching for a particular picture in the past. Great job guys!!

Downloading this app was a necessary evil at the time. And while G made it easy to get my photos to the app, It's very difficult to get them back to my phone in bulk. I sent G an email letting them know and asking for help but no one ever responded. Other complaints... Pictures that were in folders on my phone are now scattered throughout the app by date. Also... a bigger problem... MISSING PICTURES! I ordered a laptop with a huge memory so I don't have to deal with this anymore!

This is the best app ever. It makes animations when you take multiple pictures at a time, stylizes your photos automatically (but doesnt overwrite the originals), and makes collages and albums for you. Sometimes it even labels the albums for you automatically if you have location on. For example: Disneyland, Saturday December 25th. Love it.

Google photos has grown to be one of my absolute favorite apps. Being able to search my library not just by the info in the photo metadata (date taken, camera type, location, etc) but content and people is such a killer feature. Additionally, the editing tools have really matured, but some advanced features are a little bit hidden - for example, the three main sliders can be expanded for more precise tuning. Solid app.

Is there a way to go back to the version before the update? It sucks. It was way easier being able to swipe to the side and access your phone's library and archives and etc. Now I have to relearn an app that had once been so easy to use for YEARS. Please make an option to downgrade the app or go back to the old default. Highly disappointed with the new layout. It honestly kinda feels like y'all are trying to compete with Iphones gallery when there was no need for it.

This is probably the only app I'll give 5 stars. First off, it's such a valuable free service, so much online storage of photos both for archival purposes and sharing. The ability to auto backup my photos is great, if anything catastrophic happens I'm not totally pooched. The interface is intuitive and works how you'd expect it. The face organization is borderline creepy, but super handy when I want to find a certain image. Really not much to complain about. No alternative comes close.

I absolutely love this app and I have been using it for 5 years. I love that it automatically backs up all of my photos, so I can delete them off of my phone. I love that my photos are kept in order of date, as well as, placed categories such as pets, sunrises, people, cars...etc. I love that the app makes videos, collages, and animations. However, my favorite part of the app is that is send me reminders of what happened the same day years ago. Google photos is a must have!

I love this app. I do wish however that you had an option to see the photos not in albums. As well as... *****this is the most frustrating part of Google Photos for me.....***** A DUPLICATE PHOTO FINDER. I have over the years managed to accumulate multiple copies of the same photos and I have yet to find a way to erase the extra copies and leave the original. Other than that, this app is awesome.

Google photos has always been my go to. Now it's just too frustrating. When I tapped dynamic in the past it only changed the color. Now it crops and rotates!? Why!? The cropping option to move the four corners is gone? I used that on a daily basis. Am I just missing something? This app was way better before the update. At least have an option to switch between simple and advanced editing. Bad form, Google.

It's a good app. But like all Google apps the size of the apps and updates is absurd. They seem to believe they are above all apps. Wanting updates constantly. Which doesn't make half of them even work after. They already consume 80% OS, then apps are always running and demand background data on. Also their apps eat up memory and RAM and can't stop them or report them. If you do it pops right back on. I hate using Google, we need a better system,they're too controlling.

Please add the feature to search for duplicate photos! I have a ton of duplicate photos taking up storage space, but it's very time consuming trying to locate duplicate photos because they are saved in various photo albums. I'd love to see more advanced tools & filters. Other than that, pretty good app for backing up and sharing photos and albums.

I have always had sync and backup turned off. This app allows you to turn backup off but will invasively pester you to turn it on at regular intervals. There is no way to turn off these "reminders". Why Google feels they should do this is—even after I have explicitly chosen this setting—is beyond me. I remember when the computer software field was all about letting people choose how they wanted things to work. Now the tech companies tell you how to do things, and pretty much force it upon you.

When I opened my Photos editor today, I reacted with cursing I'd rather not put in this review. I got my bearings relatively quickly, but a lot of people won't. I thought I was in the beta for Photos. 🤔 Had that been so, I would've left feedback saying that people who don't jive with technology are going to hate these changes. Also, the new photo search is terrible, and my auto-sorted pet pictures are all mixed up! Classic search should always be optional in settings. Fix that now, please.

Because of the recent update, a bunch of my pictures changed. Some are blurry when they used to not be, some look pixelated, and the new way of storing multiple shots in one stack is so annoying to sift through. I hate how you it's not compatible with any app on my Pixel, and I hate how stupid the storage system is. If I download a photo, it takes ten minutes to find it. I wish they would stop making changes and just let my photos be.

Pros: Almost everything. Cons: 1: While uploading photos it consumes quite a chunk of our batteries. 2: Since last update, Search bar and Library tab became more of an issue then solving matters. For older folks, it is really uncomfortable way of hard to find photos from different sources then Camera. Suggestion: Make a very hidden setting (as you usually do) where you can revent to old view.

Here's the deal, when you want to share,say an album, that's in photos, it is a monumental pain in the ass!¿! There should be a direct line from messenger, to photos, instead you are met with way over the top complexity trying to do something as simple as sharing a file. I could increase your sales by no less than 30% with a few, very simple modifications, I guarantee it!¿! You have my email, Hit me back, just to chat, truly yours, your biggest fan, it's Callaghan!¿!

Have had several phones in the last couple of years die out of nowhere which erased all of my photos each time. I began using Google photos to keep everything safe from phone to phone. has been better than I imagined! everything syncs perfectly and is stored. Also, an added benefit I was happy to discover was the assistant. It will group similar photos together to make collages, show you videos of a certain day, or even make an album by itself titled "best smiles of 2018." love this service.

Spend hours of my life trying to share albums in the past few months - it keeps returning error to try again later... Also any new album created on the one device will no apoear on another device and vice verse. At the same time the photos are syncing - the backed up photos from each device would appear on the other one. But the app isn't that useful without having the option to organize photos in albums that would sync across devices and that are shareable.

This app served us well, but it served google better. Now that the benefit of additional data is low for training image models... There is no free storage. The app has great AI, flashback, editing, etc features; but lacks common sense features like every thing is sorted timeline wise ALWAYS. Example issue: you edited a photo from 10 years ago and saved a copy... Now in order to find that pic, you have to scroll down till infinity again!

I find this feature awesome and also creepy. The fact that all my photos are being scanned through to create these videos, stylized photos, collages, etc.. makes me a bit uneasy if I'm being honest. However, I don't always want to take the time to make these things for Holidays, or Birthdays, and such so they are often appreciated. One more note, I have some "personal" photos that occasionally get mixed in with pictures of my kids, and therefore some videos come with a little...surprise!

The most recent update is terrible; I keep uninstalling it. The eraser is no longer intuitive- no matter how specific I try to be in selecting an item to erase, it'll automatically select a much larger area. I also really miss the ability to reimagine the background. Since the update, it is a painstaking process to try to manually select the background, and when you manage to select it all accurately, the results are awful. Being able to generate new results is also missing. Disappointing.

Erases my pictures and is impossible to find anything. There is no one folder with all pictures in it, you have to find which folder the idiots who designed this put them in, and they often will disappear altogether. This is the worst photo app I've ever used in my entire life. Get it together, have an option to look after ALL pictures at once, and DON'T AUTOMATICALLY DELETE ANY OF THEM, EVER! How hard is that?

It's like my albums don't exist. I never made them private, because in my case, there's no option to. I also lost the option to back up my photos. Restarted phone multiple times. Now they're in some kind of limbo when I try to upload my photos to flickr. These are my carefully and lovingly editted photos that I can do nothing with. Would give zero stars if I could, switching to a different app forever.

Edit: if I could I would take away the one star because of then "bot" feedback. I don't have issues adding photos or achieving them later on. I have a problem that when I'm adding multiple pictures to an album I have to re-sekect then again just to archive. There is not a single "button". No option to add photos to a folder and in the same time to archive them. It's primitive and has only very basic options. I'm wondering how productively people can use it to manage their collection of photos.

Overall it is a great app. Though, like other people, I have been experiencing problems. One, even though all my photos are backed up and synced, it doesn't show some of my important photos and videos. Next, my photos and videos are scattered, and not in order of how it was in order. I have a couple of other bugs, where it kicks me from the app, just shows a white screen, etc. I still like this app, though it can be better.

I hate the complications of the app, the fact that it has folders and albums but not all of your photos are there. Folders show up on Instagram to upload but albums don't and neither does the rest of the photos unless you go through all of the options but then you can only pick 1. Unnecessarily awkward to use, it's the worst photo app I've ever had to use.

Ok, so you´ve got all the fancy new functions, photoalbums, Assistent and bla bla.. but it got too clever, too far, too automatic, too prone to human arbitration. The app doesn´t allow you to for example manually change order of photos.  Few really disturbing things:  1) Why the heck when you make an album (upload from PC, photos in the PC are put in PC from phone by cable) are the photos chaotically disordered? They are not in the order of how you took them, they are mixed.  Google Photos reads wrong data info of the photos from computer.. Not when created (took), but when last edited.   2) Even worse (!), you can´t manually change the order. You can just go from the oldest, of from the youngest. That´s the problem. The app (or Google, or developers of the app) thing, that they are smarter than you. So they ban the option to manually change order of any photos in any album. In the end, totally useless, anger producing.

Very easy to use app with a few serious flaws. First, there's no way to tell it to cache an album on the device for offline viewing. Second, there's annoying popups on nearly every single photo offering to fix it in one way or another that get in the way of showing photos to others and can't be turned off, only temporarily hidden. Also be aware that you have zero privacy with Google photos. They scan every single photo you upload to train their AIs and to data mine to show you more ads.

Edited 14/06/22: I read the article and did what it suggested. It has made no difference. I removed a star because the suggestion to do all those things to an app that's been working fine annoyed me. Edit 13/06/2022: crashes every time I swipe up on a photo to add to an album. In recent updates, I have noticed a lot of bugs. I rely so heavily on Google Photos (I was previously a Picasa user), and would love this to be fixed asap. Does what is expected of it and is easy to use.

Search feature is great. The reason for only 3 stars is there are NO FOLDERs to better organize Albums. I have 100s of albums and would like to organize them into folders such as Trips, Family, Christmas, Work etc. It would make it much easier to find the album I want to add photos to. Google please ! This is my big ask. Then I will happily rate GPhotos 5:stars.

Photos have suddenly gone missing from the photos tab on pixel 7 pro after the last update. Update: No longer an issue as it turns out that I was logged into a different account. But I am giving a 4 star review still as I still see some pics only in one of the accounts, although the backup is turned off completely on all the accounts. Also pls give an option to save edits on the same pic (with an option to rollback the edits), instead of always having to save changes into a separate pic.

love this app. so easy to use. Automatically uploads my photos when i take them. I can see my photos from my phone, laptop, desktop or tablet. Albums are a great way to organize your photos. I do wish you could choose the sorting option. it appears it short albums by last viewed. no biggie, but would be a nice feature. Google Photos is really the best!!

Definitely lacking some very key features, such as duplicate files finder for all file types. Surprisingly, quite a few popular, common formatting file extension types that can't view can not be viewed in Photos. The other surprising setbacks are the inability to compress files, plus there is no easy way to change a file's format from a .jpg file to a .png file, for example. Thank you for your consideration.

This app is pretty good. Definitely, recommend it to friends and family. However, I do have a few gripes about it.   Why oh why, can we not download Albums for offline viewing on mobile devices? Its silly that Google can pick out my dogs face out of thousands of pictures, but can't save an album to the device for offline viewing.  Speaking of picking my dog out of my pictures, I have had this app for years, and an account as well, and the People and Pets section is still only People. Please fix!  So far those are the only issues I can say about it.  So many good things though. Removing photos from the device after confirming they are on the cloud, in order to free up space on the device. Picking my dog out of thousands of photo's is very impressive, even if I have to search for animals instead my dogs name. And last but not least, the assistant, puts together nice collages, memory videos, and automatic albums based on location and time periods.  Well made, with many convenient features. However still lacking a few important ones.

Great app for storing your many pictures. It is great at organising your pictures. It also gives you a history of photos you took on a significant date years ago which is very nostalgic. It's a great app to use and you will enjoy having your photos stored here. If you lose your device all you have to do is remember your Google account and password and you'll have access to your pictures again.

This is a great photo managing app. Best parts are the automated albums! I love how when I take photos, it can tell who is in them, cats included! I have both of my cats names set in the app, and it can tell when I take a picture of either of them and label it correctly! The UI is intuitive, and the suggestions it provides are actually useful. It is now my goto photo app (even better than the built in gallery), and it'll help keep photos backed up if my phone ever dies or if I get a new one.

Very Good Application. No matter what device I'm using I can always access my photos and videos without the use of a memory card. The downside is that in order to access some files on photos I would have to be connected to the internet. Another issue is not all files are automatically backed up and if you do not manually backup those files you run the risk of losing those files.

Overall nice gallery and photo editor. However it nagged me to update to get the "latest features", and now I'm sorry I did. The only thing that seems to be added is more frequent nags that my photos are not backed up. I use a different system to backup my photos. PLEASE add a way to turn this off. Annoying the **** out of me is not going to make me decide to use your service. In fact I was considering switching over, but now I'm not.

Works great. Keeps photos mostly organized... It identifies and organizes people as they age which is nice when you want to sort per person... groups well, just haven't figured out how to auto add in the right album... but it is auto added, lol probably lack of sorting on my part, takes time to group, add each group of photos which I'm not so great at... it is unlimited storage, at least until June 2021... then they count against your quota...15GB a person. I'm currently using the free version!

Once pictures are edited, Google photos clear your editing, it takes time to edit photos and notice that you got to go back and redue your editing. Even though Google photos have unlimited data usage, Im unable to revise my photos. The photo books that I order from Google are terrible, color is awful, shows all blemishs. Shutterfly photos come out much better looking, including Gallery has much more options to offer to make your photos brighter and makes photos the way that you'd like.

I haven't used the app as much since they made changes last year. It's less intuitive, harder to scroll through memories, setting made less accessable, harder to find other features I used to like, like the gifs. It still automatically makes them, but they're more buried so I never look. And it's not that I'm not tech savvy. I recently got a degree having to do with computer databases. This app is just plain a less plesent experience then it used to be. Everytime I open the app I'm disappointed.

Best for organizing/finding photos. Editing, collage tools, etc. are too limited to make this my only photo app, but its strengths are noteworthy. I'm befuddled when I show someone a pic from ten years ago and they ask how I have so many photos on my phone. Well, I don't... But gPhotos helps me find and share in a snap. What's missing? PLEASE make it so I can ARCHIVE OR DELETE suggested images. Too often I see pics I'd rather delete mixed in suggested archives, but there's no easy way to do so.

I am highly upset and disappointed, I've been using Google backup for yeeeearrrssssss now and I've never had a problem, but I guess as I see other commenters saying ever since ya'll updated the app. I'm missing photos, videos and albums this is CRAZY!!! I have alot of precious memories and things that I can't get back!!! I don't know what you did, but ya'll really need to fix this or I see a lawsuit coming!!!! I trusted Google backup, never had a problem now this....

This app has way too many categories. I would just like to be able to view my photos. And it's always trying to get me to do things and look at things. I just want the damn phone to be a tool rather than an advertising platform, I wouldn't recommend Moto g in general (that is the type of phone I'm using) and Google photos is just too busy for my taste. The edit features are fine. I do like the option to keep photos in a locked photo album.

I like the app alright. It syncs fine to my phone, but I wish it was better at syncing when I'm on a computer. Also, why can't it be set up so we can create sub-albums? I HATE that I can only create single albums. I'd like to have them by year, and then smaller albums within each year. Especially paying for storage, you'd think you could make that a feature...

Facial recognition and search options are awesome! Free storage WAS a big help, too... Now, it's a somewhat less valuable consumption of a limited resource intended to drive sales of another piece of the ecosystem into which so many have become a part. Unfortunately the Billions and Billions in profits are no longer enough. One of these days, I hope to see the value of the casual consumer return to prominence. I will not hold my breath, though...

The program is great for being able to save my photos from my phone and see them on my other devices without having to transfer them. I love being able to search based on faces, places, or objects. Two features I wish where there: 1. Being able to print directly from the app on my phone or computer. 2. Have the collage more customizable. Similar to what used to be available on Picaso.

My main issue is that I'm constantly trying to find my photos after editing them. There is a feature that groups original photos with the edited ones, together in one "file"...which results in me having to scroll forever to get to the original to find the newly edited one. This is such a departure from how my gallery used to be, before Google Photos, which I really miss.

The backup feature is amazing, and makes it easy to access photos from different devices. However, it's a bummer that even if you pay for high quality photo storage, any use of the editor will crush the quality of a photo to the size of the free version. I thought I would be able to upload DSLR pics from my laptop and leisurely sort them and tweak lighting on my phone, or even from the website on pc. Nope! Not unless I want to defeat the purpose of using a real camera.

Horrible app, especially if your phone uses it as the default gallery, in which case you're basically forced to pay the $0.99 fee for storage. Downloaded videos dont appear in the app, and It's ui is not user-friendly in the slightest. Samsung and Apple default galleries are way easier to work with. While google Photos offers options like backup, it usually causes more bad than good. Unless you have no other way to back up your photos and videos, I would not recommend it.

Couldn't help but need to comment for this time. The new update feels lacking the colors and the user friendliness that it used to have. Prefer the previous version over this newest update. Couldn't really find the share album, particularly the album that automatically shared by others that has certain people in the pictures. Still prefer the bigger thumbnail of the albums and more color-vibrant interface. The autogenerated highlight was not bad though.

Constant push notifications. Very needy app that constantly sends me notifications of pictures that have been backed up. No, I do not want a custom memory of the four work photos I took last Tuesday. Why do you think anyone wants this? Wish it would just quietly backup my photos as new phones have such limited internal storage. Not sure why I need to micro manage every apps push notification settings. It's becoming ridiculous.

I LOVE this app, it's very easy to use and wonderful for my photos, not to mention a great and cheap way to store my photos, and keep them from getting lost. It's very organized, and has wonderful features such as letting you create albums to organize your photos even more than by dates. The only problem I have with it, is that when I try to use Face Identification sometimes it doesn't sense a face as being there, and won't let me pare it. I'd like to be able to do that. Otherwise, love it!

Generally a good app, but it is lacking in some basic features in favor of complex and unnecessary ones. Really MUST have the ability to rename photos directly (needing to open the Files app just for that is ridiculous), suggest new names when copying (if same name, such as after an edit), save copies in different formats (like png), and to sort by filename. I only use this app to view and search my images. I have pretty much all extra features disabled, because they are irrelevant to me.

If it's just me, loading slow, backup isn't working, I've changed settings, it just hangs on blank page with "choose folders" at the to. tried manual, got some things backed up, but takes an incredibly long time. I also don't see the search feature s I see others posting about. I'd really love to be ad wt25dle to fully use this :( THx

This is a great app. It allows so much photos, the suggestions are terrific, it shows how smart it is. The app also let's you create slideshows and even order photos off of it. Photo albums too. The software recognizes faces and let's you search almost anything and it can recognize it. I took a photo of a friend's baby and the app grouped it with someone else's pictures. I thought it was a fluke but I looked closely and saw that person in a frame in the corner. Wow.

Very slow to get only 2 photos to post and they won't stretch to read narrative. My old Android 4 did many things to make more artistic posts and even had music choice s . Help?!?!! 8/20/19 above still no advice. Other than that good so far.

I'm not sure how this app could get anything less that 5stars. It literally does everything for you. From creating albums by familiar faces to Scanning QR Codes. Now I do understand the storage issue. I've had Google photos since it hit the app store lol and I know for a fact it gets upgraded at least once a year, sometimes more and it is based on your phone whether the upgrade will update automatically BTW. But this does take up huge amounts of storage , storage is very important as we all kno

As others commented, since a couple of months the app doesn't back up/sync correctly. Settings are set correctly. Sometimes I let a minimised netflix movie play and have Google Photos open, so hopefully my photos back up... I'm shocked. I've always been a big fan of Photos, but now I can't use it anymore as it doesn't sync with pictures I take (takes days?), so I'm using Samsung gallery now. Crazy O_o

Cant see entire sub menu anymore without having to scroll. Also, my folders on my device have been automatically deleted by Google Photos, making it difficult to find photos to submit in other apps. I had to spend over an hour to find and recreate all of my folders on my device because other apps won't allow me to find and upload photos from Google Albums.

Not sure if this "it". Storage is a great option, in fact, I found a number of photos I have been able to find, uploaded from a few phones back, awesome! However, ordering by date is less important to me, although it's good as a reminder of where I was or what I was doing. As a minimum, I would like to tag photos, or create categories where I can see an album of related image, as with Samsung Gallery, this is how I find what I like to revisit. Just now, it's just a massive stack of images.

there are many many bad qualities to this app but what I hated most was that it deleted 300 of my pictures to "free up space" and didn't give me the chance to choose which would be deleted. Of course I can still save back to my device but the quality of the picture isn't as great. Also the dates get messed up which makes the photo harder to find back as it wouldn't be in the same range as another photo that was taken on the same day.

I love Google Photos. I am trusting them with so many years of my life and I feel secure in that. The app is great, easy to use, easy to edit all the things I'd want to edit. They have just the right amount of usefull filters. And their search... I mean... BEST SEARCH OF ANY APP EVER!! No one else can even come close to being as useful and accurate as the search.

Used to be a great app. Was a bit annoyed that google removed the automatic backup as an option a while ago, but usually remembered to open & back up every few days or so, but following the last update I have about 30 photos not backed up and it's stuck on 'Getting ready to back up' and saying I have nearly 4000 photos to back up? WTAF? It seems to think I have not backed up any photos... Ever... Despite them being visible when I actually look on my google account on the computer...

DO NOT USE. When you use this for back up and delete photos/videos from the app for more storage, it will also delete them from the device itself. Which isn't how backups are supposed to work. No one will buy more storage if they could delete unimportant photos first. UPDATE: I turned off back up and it still backs up my photos... so the solution I found is to remove access for the app and then do the sorting and stuff in Google Photos in the web. In the end, I really had to stop using the app.

Easy to use. Easy to find pictures. Uploads fast. I love magic eraser and Snapseed. Ordering pictures and changing the aspect ratio is more difficult than needs to be. That should be a feature right within the order photo tab. Otherwise, have to go to Snapseed and use expand so that photos that are printed don't crop the people you're trying to get a picture of.

Google photos does a great job of photo analysis. It can stitch together multiple photos to automatically create panoramic photos. It will make some "auto awesome" adjusts to some photos and ask if you like it to then save the new photo. Further to this, it will also automatically (usually) create an album if you travel and take photos. This is one of my favorite features. It usually chooses a subset of the best pictures and videos from your collection of photos taken while away and puts them all together in an album

This is 7-4-22. The markup feature STOPPED WORKING 3 DAYS AGO! I refuse to update this app. I'm afraid of MORE unexpected negative consequences. EACH TIME I upgrade phones they "suddenly" develop problems WITHIN 3-4 MONTHS. About 3 years ago, I read somewhere that some providers were caught making phones mess up so customers would think they needed new ones. IDK if its true, but I'm never buying another upgrade. My flip phones without internet are cheaper & never had issues.

The issues below seem to have been resolved. Bumping my review up to 3 stars. Preserving my comments below in case some poor soul has the same issues and comes across it. Know that your pain was shared, lonely soldier... I can't see my old photos anymore. My uploads are not going through, I'm not able to add photos to albums. My videos keep buffering. They just won't play! I have ~7 years worth of photos and videos backed up here. I can't even pack up and move to a different app.

I am really enjoying the app and I like the back up system. Fast and easy. I was able to save so many memories and be able to access them from any device. I am a little bit sad, since unlimited backup stopped and it's unnecessarily expensive. I would like to suggest that maybe you could give 15GB every year for free instead of unlimited. Either way I want to thank you for the app

Photos is a wonderful way to share photo albums with others!! It's also possible to purchase prints through it which I intend to take advantage of. The app has had its share of minor issues, but I've always gotten it to work, and these problems are being gradually ironed out. Overall its quality and usefulness far outweigh the minor issues and I'll continue to use it regularly!

Always find my favorite pictures with ease and am able to edit and share them with everybody. It is so valuable to have all of my pictures in one place, both on my phone and PC. I can search my photos by "term" for example "beehives" or "pond" and it will find all pictures containing it! It can be that specific. I dazzle my friends by being able to recall albums of photos instead of scrolling through randomly. I take the time to make albums with only the best pics in them to show off! Its great

Easy to organize photos in different albums. I really like the Locked Folder option to hide some photos. Limited editing, but I do not do much editing so it is perfect for me. I prefer this program to the Gallery program preinstalled on my phone. There are fun things to do such as animations and videos. Links right to an option to make photo books and so on. Any "glitches" or such have been minimal for me and I have been able to figure them out myself. Thank you!

Overall a messy app. Hard to organize pictures, hard to transfer pictures between devices, inconvenient layout. It's ridiculous to have the same photo in a folder, the main photo gallery, and whatever albums you put it into. It just makes the whole app super cluttered, so that whenever you want to find a picture in the main photo gallery you have to scroll past potentially thousands of pictures that you've already organized. The differentiation between a folder and an album is asinine.

Good for organizing photos into albums and finding them by various methods. The biggest issue is that there is no way to find out if you forgot to place a photo in an album. If you did, it will get lost in your main feed and won't be able to find it later. Such a basic feature yet Google doesn't seem realize it's a problem for many. OK app if you have a small to medium collection, otherwise find something else where your photos won't get "lost" if you forget to put them in an album.

I love that I can back up my photos from my phone into Google photos. I also love being able to organize the photos into albums that are easily accessed when blogging, etc. Plus it is easy to share and choose whether to share it public or private. It also automatically organizes pictures by location too. One of the best apps ever. There are even more great features that are easily learned. Give it a try, if you haven't already.

While the search features with Photos is excellent, I do not appreciate being backed into a corner of having to pay for storage space now for that access to continue. Also, biggest issue is when you initially take a photo, it pixelates and goes blurry. You have to swipe away or close out to see a good image. And the relationship with Facebook app is still not there so I can only upload from gallery rather than Photos.

Awesome app if your text savvy. And even if you're not, all you got to do is read and follow the directions. It may get frustrating at times, but it gets easier. You can put things in different spots and albums, and such, and free up space even though it's in another space under the same 15 gig limit... A lot of stuff can be done. I switching things around.

Dreadful new set up. Can't find anything very easily & found it extremely difficult to create a new album. You've only got 2 stars cos you're known to be reliable with storing photos - & at least it found a load of empty folders that I was able to delete. However, apart from that, I don't really have anything good to say about it. Edit from 2 years ago. Can no longer use the app to edit new albums, & now have to go to the website to edit them.

The app is useful for clearing storage and protecting my pictures. My only complaint is that sometimes photos will be placed in an album that isn't the person it belongs to, or just not in an album at all leaving me to search for the pic & manually add to their album. I could understand if they looked alike or were in the photo together then yes they should be in BOTH not just ONE yet when it happens no resemblance no shared photos, have NEVER been in photos together.

Excellent app! I love how it creates animations, videos and collections on its own. I did a home project recently over the span of a couple weeks taking periodic pictures of the progress. A few days after the project was completed, I received a slideshow which pulled out only the pictures of the project. Awesome feature! It also creates then & now pictures if my kids and pulls together albums like "best of summer 2018" which are typically the pictures I would have chosen to pull into an album as well. To get a printed photo album out of the app is also possible, but pretty expensive. Overall, one of my favorite apps... although recently the automatic assistant creations have slowed in their frequency. Hopefully this feature improves as I do look forward to seeing what the app pulls together. It's both amazing and a little creepy at how well it does.

Love this app for sharing and other perks. The "assistant" feature surprises you with animations made from clips of your videos or photos. It's so fun to open it up and see what visual treats await! I started exploring this option only recently however and it looks like everything it made prior to then is gone. Really wish I could salvage those!! Archive suggestions also useful - finds receipts, papers, etc and offers the option to archive them to the cloud while freeing up space on your phone.

The panorama stitching is perfect. It automatically created some panorama shots out of my photos and they're were unbelievable. Similarly, the search is incredible. It's borderline wonder. Edit: 09/22/2020 Almost 5 years of continuous use and I have one issue to report. Photo upload feature has been dicey past few months and uploaded photos take too long to sync across the devices. Not sure what went wrong with the uploader. Even on a fast Wi-Fi network, uploading is way too slow.

When I first found the video collage feature it was really cool! You could select several photos and videos and it would automatically assemble them into a short video clip with music in the background. But then it stopped allowing videos to be included. Later it stopped working all together. It would go through the entire process but then once it completed, the completed video is not there. I'm looking forward with hope that they'll get it working again.

The feature list is amazing, but even with the latest Pixel phone, the app just keeps getting slower and slower. Searching typically takes so long I give up, it won't delete backed up photos, new photos take hours to show up, and I have switched to Gallery Go for viewing photos on my phone. I did a factory reset on my phone, and not even that helped. I am looking for an alternative.

UPDATE: reducing from 3 to 2. Photos makes neat collages etc. I click on a notification to see one. Wait too long, poof it's gone. Random slideshow starts, no way to find the collages. Didn't save in time. Reducing from 5 to 3. The backup is solid. But I hate the new galleries / "this date x years ago" view. I can't zoom, I'm always fighting it going forward and backward, and it skips off to other years. I find myself fighting the UI and frustrated with it almost always when viewing.

Getting better, but still unclear when it comes to accessing different directories, It doesn't seem able to find images, even when you tell it where to look. Kind of laggy on pixel 3. new editing interface is difficult to use, and makes the picture so small that it's hard to see what changes might have happened. just once I would like an app to be designed by people who actually might use it at some time.

Overall the app functions fine, but I find that I have trouble with organization. Editing is a breeze and even fun, though I really need to edit with the awesome pixel camera. I need an option to select (and delete or move) ALL photos from a certain location, or say, find all photos with dogs in them. I know how to search, but results are hit or miss. With over 300K photos, organization is a nightmare. Don't want to buy storage. Please increase organization and mass location select.

Please put back "View Recent Activity". Was very helpful for shared albums. Also I was able to at one point have my photos backed up without having to always go into the Photos app. It no longer does that. It will only back up photos if we go into the app. Please put it back the setting where it will automatically back up photos if we do not go into the app. App is no longer syncing with my photos in Google photos on the desktop. There are photos shown there that aren't shown on my phone app.

When you back your slowmo videos into photos and delete it off of your device, it makes the whole video in slowmotion instead of just the part you edited. This has been a problem for years, and they still havent fixed it. The app is really easy to use, and the Assistant makes it easy to find photos from trips. It automatically makes slideshows. Also recently, when I back up videos, I can't view them

Inconsistent interface. E.g., some contexts allow for larger photo thumbnails while others do not. So if there are multiple photos of the same scene, it is difficult to pick the best one because the thumbnail is too small. The album sharing feature is a poor effort. When trying to share, not all users presented by Photos can be invited and Photos does not offer an explanation.

I like Google Photos a lot, I've used it for several years. The cloud backup and partner sharing are pretty seamlessly integrated, and the app as a whole is quite simple to use. The in app editing features could use a total overhaul, they're boring, unimpressive, and not very well executed, but that's the lowest point as far as I'm concerned. It is great for photo storage, sharing, and making albums easily, but in app editing isn't noteworthy at all. Definitely get a separate app for that.

Just awesome! The automatic stories are great (the dates might be a little off if you are on a different time zone) the ability to find old photos by date, or people (as long as you tag them) and places (as long as your GPS indicator is turned on in your camera). And the ability to edit photos and share them with your friend for them to download, without having to create a bunch of emails is great!

Great photo storage, managing, editing, viewing and sharing app. Only one thing could make it better... the ability to show only photos that you haven't added to your albums - so you can see which ones still don't have a 'home' - either as a fixed feature, or one that can be toggled on or off. This way, you'll know which photos have not been 'categorised'.

This has been my go to photo storage solution for nearly five years since it was released. I have to downgrade it from 5 to 3 stars, however, for two reasons. 1) the free photo storage option for compressed "high quality" photos is being removed, and this just about kills the usefulness of this app. 2) the improvement in features over the last five years has been really minimal. I really expected the app to be a lot further along by this point, tons of features missing.

I love the feature of backing EVERY SINGLE PHOTO on all my devices. I wish the app had a "Favorite" feature to get to all my best pics easier, however. I really like the Assistant that creates collages, movies, animations, albums, etc. but I wish you could edit them to change out certain images (and perhaps change that awful music it adds to the movies).

Easy access to pics on phone and computer, easy to use, enjoy their stylized pics, and memories. Not great for labeling pics, which would make it easier to reference or find later. Also would prefer to have better options for making collage, putting the pics in the specific spot I want them in. It needs improved searching for specific pics. Would like option to make a movie/slide show in the sequence I put photos in an album. And with more than 50 photos.

Free unlimited storage of high quality photos is a great thing in itself, but it's so much more. The auto creation of animations, panorama's, stylised photos etc. is fun, as well as being transported back to good old memories with 'Remember This Day'. It's also a reliable and simple way to create a shared album where everyone can put their photos from a particular event in the same place for all to enjoy!

It"s brilliant. The more you find out about it, the better it gets. Except for the lack of ability to sort Albums by anything other than date. Why on earth can't each photo be moved up or down the list, so you can arrange them exactly how you want them. This facility exists widely in other applications, why not in Google photos. Marking down a star because of this.

The new update makes the app unfortunately cumbersome to use. I liked having all of my pictures in one area, and being able to exclude libraries when necessary. Now, different folders are segregated and I have to go to library and find the photo folders I use most often. Cannot find a way to change this. Will be switching applications to something more usable and streamlined.

The positive, SD cards can & do fail so irreplaceable media like photos are always backed up. The negative. The app gives me an option to only save from certain folders, but I can't be sure if I allow access it won't 'find' that folder, & delete from it. I'd prefer to have the option of deleting from the cloud only.

Welp, it's great, but if you shoot sports at high frame rates it totally sucks. It will not put your photos in chronological order if the shot-to-shot time is less than 1 second. When I shoot at 10 frames per second the sequence shows out of order. Please fix this and I'll give more stars. Until then, 1 star... Update Oct 2021: The photos are now in order, except when they are in an album. For some reason, the albums didn't get the chronological update like the main photos did. Almost there.

Major problem with zoom. After viewing photo with zoom it is highly likely to hang. The bug quite easily reproduced, just open photo zoom in, then zoom out, then go to next photo and repeat. I'm not able to watch 10 photos this way and I need to close the program and reopen it. As result, the process of cleaning photos is a nightmare. Please make it easier and faster. Please also do some speed optimization for adding a photo to an album.A very nice to have feature: a list of albums photo belongs

I use Photos on a daily basis and see myself using it as long as I'm taking pictures, which will be the rest of my life. There are so many options that I still haven't used it to it's full potential. I love how it identifies by people's faces, searches for them if you need, even creates memory books with the option to order a printed hard cover copy (paid, of course), allows you to free up space on your phone by deleting originals. I pay willingly for storage for that option.

Used to be great, until it started crashing every single time I used it... Now it just keeps popping up messages that it's stopped working even when I'm not using it. The definition of a nuisance app. The only reason I still keep it is that it still backs up my photos so I can at least still look at albums and creations on my computer. Update: the app seems outdated and complicated to navigate. You think they'd have streamlined it by now.

I love the surprises from the photo assistant -memories, special effects, collages and more! And the automatic upload. I didn't give 5 stars because: although the search usually gives adequate results, it sometimes yields nothing on a keyword that should be simple enough (or totally wrong results) , and albums are difficult to search. This app... Let's say that I had a lot of problems while using this app. Firstly, I couldn't edit pictures due to a certain error; secondly, whenever I moved my photos to my new album, it didn't show up as if the app didn't know that these images were in the said album; lastly, the compression after I trimmed the video was definitely unnecessary. With this in mind, I hope you guys will take action against these problems.

I love this app, it has a lot of great features and has been storing my images for years. However I have had 1 consistent problem, albums. Whenever I make an album and put my photos there I don't want to see it on my main reel of photos anymore. I can never actually finish organizing all of them if the ones I've already categorized are still in the way. I even pay monthly for extra storage.

There's a lot of good here, especially the editing features. But photo organization lags behind other options. You can't edit photos within an album: You need to find the photo in your main library instead. You also can't download photos from albums (same issue). I really like most of the app and would love to give it more, but the library organization capabilities really make it inconvenient at times.

I had my photos neatly organized in folders with descriptive names. I just got a new phone. Google Photos "said" it had backed up my photos. It had, but in the process it flattened the folder structure, deleted the few custom albums I had and, to my suprise, even emptied out albums it had created. I tried to recreate the albums, but found it impossible to do a search and then select all the results. Worse, the sort order in my first attempt was random, with the album completely ignoring the dates of the photos. Awful app.

Just recently the multiple framing, sizing & color choices were eliminated for creating collages, (on my Android) Unless these functions were bundled into a different app that was the one of the only things I liked about Photos. Making an album is dull, boring, if you want to create fun, you have to purchase a Photo Book. This is really a greedy move, Google. (I will amend if I find out I'm incorrect about the blaise` collage thing)

Update 11/30/19 Google photos is no longer auto generating albums for me or collages for me to save, since this past spring.
